summary: Iteration 21 (hamburger side menu + resume pill in header) fully validated on live preview at 844x390 landscape. ALL 8 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) menu-button visible top-left on every tab screen: Home (x=16,y=12.5,44x44), Leaderboard (16,12), Friends (16,12), Profile (16,8) — 44px min touch target respected. (2) Side menu (Modal) opens on menu-button click, renders 4 items (menu-item-home/leaderboard/friends/profile), active state confirmed via computed style (active bg rgba(0,229,122,0.1), inactive transparent). Total badge shows '3' on menu-button when tester1 has 2 friend requests + 1 room invite. menu-item-friends shows badge '2' next to label. Scrim tap (page.mouse.click(700,200)) reliably closes the panel (side-menu count 0 after tap). Navigation via each menu item lands on the correct screen. (3) NO bottom tab bar anywhere: 0 [role='tablist'] elements, 0 legacy tab-home/tab-friends/tab-profile/tab-leaderboard testIDs; only the AD banner sits at the bottom. (4) Home header 'Partie en cours' green pill (resume-game-button) appears BETWEEN avatar and ELO chip when a game is in progress: avatar x=60, resume pill x=369 w=168 h=42 y=13.5 (header region, y<80), elo pill x=699 — order avatar<resume<elo confirmed. Displays 'Partie en cours' + 'Nous 0 · 0 Eux'. Clicking navigates to /game/g_4cbdba624b1f. Initial poll fills the pill within ~1s of home mount. (5) Home content area contains ONLY the 4 mode boxes (home-grid with 2 rows × 2 cards = 4 items). ZERO inline banners in content area — verified via DOM query: no resume-game-banner testID (legacy removed), no invite-join-*/invite-dismiss-*/duo-invite-* testIDs even when tester1 has a pending room invite. Grid bbox stable at x=16 y=78 width=812 height=274 with or without active game (pill stays in header, not content). (6) Invitations via bell: tester2 created private room L4BL22 and invited tester1 via /api/rooms/L4BL22/invite → tester1's bell badge shows '3', menu-button badge '3', opening notifications-bell renders notif-invite-join-L4BL22 (bbox x=569 y=98.5 w=81 h=34), invoking join navigates to /room/L4BL22. (7) Full solo loop still works: play-solo-card → match-type-short creates /game/g_* in bidding phase (verified via GET /api/games/current returning {phase: 'bidding', hand_number: 1, my_team: 0}). (8) Profile/Friends/Leaderboard all render correctly with menu button top-left, no overlap with titles or content. Only cosmetic non-blocking warnings persist: 'shadow* style props deprecated' and 'transform-origin invalid DOM property' (both unchanged since iteration 18-20). ONE minor pre-existing UX issue detected: the notifications bottom-sheet modal is 427px tall which exceeds the 390px viewport height on landscape → panel bbox reports y=-37 (top clipped ~37px above viewport). All items inside remain visible/tappable (Playwright JS click works; regular click fails 'outside viewport' due to modal container transform). Not a regression from iter 21 changes but worth polishing later.

issues: At 844x390 landscape, the notifications-panel bottom-sheet is 427px tall (padding SP.xl top+bottom + handle + title + 250px ScrollView + close button) which exceeds the 390px viewport, causing the modal's top ~37px to be clipped above the viewport. Not blocking — content and buttons remain visible/tappable — but the sheet handle and section title 'Notifications' appear cut off. Consider reducing padding to SP.md or capping ScrollView maxHeight to 180 on short viewports. Pre-existing; not a regression from iter 21.

Console warnings ''shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'.' emitted repeatedly by react-native-web for cards using the `shadow` spread from /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Cosmetic. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: bottom-sheet notifications modal on landscape 390-height viewport clips top ~37px (see design_issues). Consider reducing paddingSP.xl → paddingSP.md or ScrollView maxHeight → 180 on short viewports in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx styles.modalSheet.

critical_code_review_comments: MenuButton.tsx implementation is clean: single Modal + Pressable scrim + Animated.View panel with SlideInLeft entrance. `active` state derived from usePathname === `/${key}` — works because expo-router keeps tab screens mounted and pathname reflects the currently-focused route.
MenuButton uses `router.navigate` (not push) so navigating menu-item-home → menu-item-leaderboard → menu-item-home does not accumulate stack — correct for tab-like navigation.

MenuButton badges: home = invites.length + duoInvites.length, friends = friendRequests.length. Total badge (btn) = sum. Verified live: 2 friend reqs + 1 invite → menu-button badge='3', menu-item-friends='2', menu-item-home='1' (embedded in the '3' total). Correct.

home.tsx headerRow layout: MenuButton (44) → Avatar (44) → info block (flexShrink:1) → headerMiddle (flex:1 center) with resume-pill → eloPill → bellBtn. Verified bounding boxes confirm pill sits horizontally between the username block and the elo pill on 844-wide viewport. On narrower widths, headerMiddle flex:1 + pill maxWidth:340 gracefully shrinks — no overlap observed.

home.tsx removes legacy resume-game-banner and inline invite/duo banners: verified 0 count in DOM even with active game + pending invite. Content area now truly reserved for the 4-mode grid as requested.
TabsInner in (tabs)/_layout.tsx replaces default tabBar with `<View><AdBanner /></View>` — confirmed no [role='tablist'] rendered on any of the 4 tab screens.

Solo game resume: on page reload the poll may take ~1-4s to populate currentGame (async storage token hydration + first /games/current call). Not a bug but a UX consideration — could show a skeleton pill during the first poll if desired.

Notifications modal (home.tsx) uses fixed padding SP.xl top+bottom + ScrollView maxHeight 250 = ~427px total. At 390 landscape height, top of the sheet handle is clipped — pre-existing but visible more often now that invites are only accessible via the bell.
